episodes.instruction: Pick the red can with white top, put it in the basket with rounded edges, then lift the basket with rounded edges.
Use the left arm to place the red can in the yellow basket with open slots; the other arm lifts the yellow basket with open slots.
Use the left arm to put the cylindrical brown drink can with white markings in the oval basket with medium storage space; the other arm lifts the oval basket with medium storage space.
